sources.title: US Census county population estimates, vintage 2024
Zillow Research county ZHVI, all homes, smoothed seasonally adjusted

limitations: Population vintage ends in 2024; download vintage is intentionally pinned for reproducibility.
ZHVI is a modeled home-value index, not land prices or individual closed sales.
Scoring is a screening heuristic, not a validated forecast or probability.
Permits, employment, parcel GIS, municipal boundaries, ETJ, floodplain and property sales require additional sources.
